fuente.titulo: Pope Leo XIV celebrates his 71st birthday

titular: Pope Leo XIV marks his 71st birthday
bajada: A year of peace appeals, foreign trips and focus on human dignity
caption: Pope Leo XIV turned 71 on September 14, 2026, closing a year marked by calls for peace, Apostolic Journeys abroad and a consistent focus on human dignity. Source: Vatican News, Sept 14, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: A softly lit Vatican courtyard at dusk, St. Peter's dome visible in the background; a figure in white papal attire stands at a distance on a balcony in the upper right third, left and center of frame open and calm.
